description: Make combineStreams take one spawn-result object so the stderr-first ordering swap is unrepresentable at the type level.

userStories.title: Change combineStreams to a single object param, update 4 call sites and 4 unit tests
userStories.description: As a plan-preflight maintainer, I need combineStreams to accept the whole spawn-result object instead of two bare (stderr, stdout) strings, so that a swapped call site cannot typecheck clean and silently reverse the load-bearing stderr-first ordering that keeps the failure verdict on the first (only surfaced) line.
acceptanceCriteria: combineStreams in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts takes a single object parameter typed structurally as { stdout: string; stderr: string } (compatible with the PlanPreflightSpawnFn result), not two bare string parameters. [oracle: grep -nE 'export function combineStreams\(\s*[a-zA-Z]+:\s*\{' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]
No call site or signature passes stderr and stdout as two separate string arguments to combineStreams. [oracle: ! grep -nE 'combineStreams\([^)]*,[^)]*\)' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]

All four failing-step call sites in runPlanPreflight pass the whole spawn-result object with no member access: combineStreams(checkout), combineStreams(pull), combineStreams(typecheck), combineStreams(tests). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'combineStreams(checkout)' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts && grep -q 'combineStreams(pull)' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts && grep -q 'combineStreams(typecheck)' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts && grep -q 'combineStreams(tests)' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]

The stderr-first join ordering is preserved: combineStreams built from an object whose stderr is 'ERRLINE' and stdout is 'OUTLINE' yields 'ERRLINE' as its first line. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]

The clean-tree step is untouched and still routes its stdout-only detail directly (not through combineStreams). [oracle: file-assert grep -q "step: 'clean-tree', detail: status.stdout.trim()" src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]

PlanPreflightSpawnFn's return type is unchanged: stderr remains a required member (no optionality added). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'stdout: string; stderr: string; exitCode: number' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]
The doc comment above combineStreams is updated to describe the single object param while still stating stderr leads the join for truncation survival. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The direct unit tests in test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts are updated to the object-argument form, keeping strict toBe assertions and all four cases (stderr-first, stdout-only, stderr-only, both-empty). [oracle: file-assert grep -qE "combineStreams\(\s*\{" test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts (combineStreams def at line 80; call sites at 98,105,125,132; PlanPreflightSpawnFn type at 31-34; clean-tree step at 118-119 stays stdout-only) and test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts (combineStreams describe block at lines 44-60). Type the new param structurally against PlanPreflightSpawnFn's result shape ({ stdout: string; stderr: string }); the object destructuring order inside the body is cosmetic but the join array must stay [stderr, stdout] (stderr first is load-bearing: detail reaches the operator FIRST-LINE-ONLY via truncatePreflightDetail, src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:135-139, consumed at src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:1607). Do NOT change PlanPreflightSpawnFn (stderr stays required) and do NOT route clean-tree through combineStreams. Gotcha: plan-preflight.ts is sidecar-executed at plan time (wired via preflightFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts), so the change only takes effect in a running sidecar after a coherence rebuild. patterns.md relevant bullet: none beyond curated noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Sweep each grep oracle red-against-main before trusting it (curated Test-quality invariant).
